mainEntity.name: Should I include my car's value as an asset?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can include it for a complete picture — use its current resale value, not what you paid. Many people leave depreciating items like vehicles out when tracking wealth-building, since they lose value every year.

mainEntity.name: How often should I recalculate my net worth?

acceptedAnswer.text: Many people track it quarterly or annually — often enough to see meaningful trends, but not so often that normal market swings feel misleading.

mainEntity.name: What is the median net worth in the US?

acceptedAnswer.text: In the Federal Reserve's 2022 Survey of Consumer Finances, the median US family net worth was $192,900 and the mean was about $1.06 million. The mean is much higher because a small number of very wealthy families pull the average up.
